Research note · manuscript under review

Digital adoption and structural change: my ECOWAS thesis question

My thesis asks whether wider ICT use is associated with changes in production and exports.

Internet and mobile phones change access to information, exchange and the way activities are organised. I am interested in what happens at the economy level: are these uses associated with changes in the structure of production?

My thesis follows fifteen ECOWAS countries from 2000 to 2023. I use two measures: industry’s share of value added and export diversification. Their definitions need to allow comparisons between countries and years.

I distinguish levels from shares and check for missing observations and breaks in the series. The analysis also needs to account for shocks that countries share and differences in their trajectories.

The method and estimates are still under review, so I do not draw a final empirical conclusion in this note. Findings will be interpreted alongside their diagnostics, limitations and robustness checks.

About this note

A note from a thesis under review. The data include World Bank WDI indicators and the export diversification indicator used in the manuscript. This is not a published academic article.
